title: Calculator context & strategy gate (guide fig. 1)
summary: Drill-down of "Context resolution": how a request reaches DSP calculation, what context is loaded, and how far the guide's PRMS strategy walk and agreement path are implemented. Mapped from field guide inputs/dsp-price-calculation.html (sha256:d260ad4216e3); every node is tagged confirmed / design-only / conflicting / code-only against code. Conceptual stages, decisions and data transformations only; not a call stack or observed runtime behaviour.

sources.note: Lines 41-49: "calculator does not yet support customer agreements" -> if HasAgreement, whole request goes to M3 retrieval; otherwise CalculatePrices.

Lines 59-122: tenant defaults (division/facility/currency/order type/warehouse), price-list table and discount model from customer, N-MONTER -> N-MONTERX, item masters, order-type defaults, control matrix, discount numbers; awaited one after another.
Lines 26-41: every OIS320MI GetCustomerPrice request sets PriceOriginSequence = "2".
Line 123: OOTYPE.PRMS ingested as CustomerOrderType.PriceOriginSequence (no reader in Dahl.Price.Calculation).

M3 Price calculation analysis: PRMS strategies (301/303/E02/E03/E08 = 6C21; 302/E01 = 621; observed X 9 6 C 2 1), agreement strategy 6 (OAGRHE valid-from asc -> OAGSET -> OAGRLN/OAGRPR, first price stops), strategy 2 (CROBJC -> price lists, OGDIPO <= 8 positions, OGDMTX, best price), NOTE2 OIS320MI PRMS overridden to 2, control matrix 10 priorities (CROBJC PC01..PC91 from 0), convert/round via MITAUN/CSYPAR/CSYTAB, cut-off to M3 to be found.
DSP Price Calculations: subscribe to M3 key tables and simulate prices outside M3 (OIS320MI cost/limits); campaign CMNO (OPRBAS/OPRICL) -> CSYTAB name/description.
Price service (2021): nightly ADF CSV -> blob -> function -> SQL; Web API via APIM, Okta. Historical; not proof of the current calculation path.

uncertainties: dsp-price copy has no .git; evidence identified by per-file sha256.
The field guide is a secondary summary (draw.io figures were unreadable to its author); Confluence pages and code are the cited evidence.
Open per Confluence 22774769: which M3 version is modelled; cut-off for calling M3 instead; whether OIS320MI "agreement first" or M3 simulation "best price incl. agreement" is the target.
Data origin (nightly ADF CSV per 22774388 v2 vs PICO subscription per 22777574 v6) stays an unresolved conflict; see parent layers.
New nested layer id: auto-layout on first open; no dsp-arch-pos carryover; existing parent ids/positions unchanged.

nodes.label: Price request
nodes.responsibility: Guide vs code: conflicting. Customer, optional address, items, order type, warehouse, date. The guide request carries qty and unit; the DSP input has neither.

sources.note: Lines 5-30: request has customer/address/agreement id/items/warehouse/order type/line type/date/currency/model/table; no quantity and no requested unit.

M3 Price calculation analysis: PRMS strategies (301/303/E02/E03/E08 = 6C21; 302/E01 = 621; observed X 9 6 C 2 1), agreement strategy 6 (OAGRHE valid-from asc -> OAGSET -> OAGRLN/OAGRPR, first price stops), strategy 2 (CROBJC -> price lists, OGDIPO <= 8 positions, OGDMTX, best price), NOTE2 OIS320MI PRMS overridden to 2, control matrix 10 priorities (CROBJC PC01..PC91 from 0), convert/round via MITAUN/CSYPAR/CSYTAB, cut-off to M3 to be found.

uncertainties: Guide: request = customer, item, qty, unit, order type. Code Input has no quantity or requested unit, so no scale limit can be derived from an ordered quantity (see layer:price.api.get-prices.calculator.discount).

nodes.label: Agreement gate (retriever)
nodes.responsibility: Guide vs code: conflicting. Before the calculator: if the customer+address has an active agreement header (OAGRHE copy, status 20, valid on the price date) the whole request goes to M3 instead of DSP calculation.

sources.note: Lines 41-49: "calculator does not yet support customer agreements" -> if HasAgreement, whole request goes to M3 retrieval; otherwise CalculatePrices.
Lines 36-42 and 98-110: same agreement gate for DahlFI; agreement customers get M3 prices (gross from OVHDAHL list).
Lines 188-195: HasAgreement needs an address id; delegates to CustomerAgreementResolver.
Lines 13-37: active agreement = OAGRHE copy with customer + address, status 20, StartDate <= price date <= ValidTo (existence check only).

M3 Price calculation analysis: PRMS strategies (301/303/E02/E03/E08 = 6C21; 302/E01 = 621; observed X 9 6 C 2 1), agreement strategy 6 (OAGRHE valid-from asc -> OAGSET -> OAGRLN/OAGRPR, first price stops), strategy 2 (CROBJC -> price lists, OGDIPO <= 8 positions, OGDMTX, best price), NOTE2 OIS320MI PRMS overridden to 2, control matrix 10 priorities (CROBJC PC01..PC91 from 0), convert/round via MITAUN/CSYPAR/CSYTAB, cut-off to M3 to be found.

uncertainties: Guide strategy 6: OAGRHE (first valid by valid-from) -> OAGSET template -> OAGRLN/OAGRPR price, first price stops the walk. Code only tests that an agreement header exists, in the retriever; OAGSET/OAGRLN/OAGRPR are ingested but never read by the calculator.
No address id -> no agreement check (HasAgreement returns false).

nodes.label: M3 OIS320MI (fallback)
nodes.responsibility: Guide vs code: confirmed. ERP price API used for agreement customers (and by M3 strategies). Every request forces price origin sequence "2".

sources.note: Lines 26-41: every OIS320MI GetCustomerPrice request sets PriceOriginSequence = "2".

M3 Price calculation analysis: PRMS strategies (301/303/E02/E03/E08 = 6C21; 302/E01 = 621; observed X 9 6 C 2 1), agreement strategy 6 (OAGRHE valid-from asc -> OAGSET -> OAGRLN/OAGRPR, first price stops), strategy 2 (CROBJC -> price lists, OGDIPO <= 8 positions, OGDMTX, best price), NOTE2 OIS320MI PRMS overridden to 2, control matrix 10 priorities (CROBJC PC01..PC91 from 0), convert/round via MITAUN/CSYPAR/CSYTAB, cut-off to M3 to be found.

uncertainties: Guide lists "fall back to M3?" as open; code already falls back, but only for agreement customers (conflict recorded on the gate).
Because PRMS is forced to "2", the M3 fallback for agreement customers also skips agreement prices (Confluence 22774769 NOTE2); whether agreement prices reach any caller today is unresolved.

nodes.label: Price origin walk (PRMS)
nodes.responsibility: Guide vs code: design-only. Design: walk OOTYPE.PRMS character by character (6 agreement, 2 price list, others), first strategy with a price wins. Code: PRMS is copied into the price DB but never read; the calculator always runs the price-list path.

sources.note: Line 123: OOTYPE.PRMS ingested as CustomerOrderType.PriceOriginSequence (no reader in Dahl.Price.Calculation).

M3 Price calculation analysis: PRMS strategies (301/303/E02/E03/E08 = 6C21; 302/E01 = 621; observed X 9 6 C 2 1), agreement strategy 6 (OAGRHE valid-from asc -> OAGSET -> OAGRLN/OAGRPR, first price stops), strategy 2 (CROBJC -> price lists, OGDIPO <= 8 positions, OGDMTX, best price), NOTE2 OIS320MI PRMS overridden to 2, control matrix 10 priorities (CROBJC PC01..PC91 from 0), convert/round via MITAUN/CSYPAR/CSYTAB, cut-off to M3 to be found.

uncertainties: Strategies C, 1, X, 9 (and M, G, W, S, R, E) are not modelled in DSP.
Order types 301/303/E02/E03/E08 = 6C21 and 302/E01 = 621 are Confluence observations, not checked against data.

nodes.label: Strategy '2' path (sibling stages)
nodes.responsibility: Guide vs code: confirmed. The only executed strategy: price-list matrix -> discounts -> best price (sibling nodes in layer:price.api.get-prices.calculator).
